paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and minADE20, represented by two lines. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Examples" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "minADE20 (→)" and has a linear scale ranging from 21.00 to 24.00, with tick labels at 0.50 intervals. A blue line, marked with circular data points, begins at approximately 23.80 when the number of examples is 0, then decreases to approximately 21.80 when the number of examples is 2, continues to approximately 21.20 at 6, and ends at approximately 21.00 at 8. An orange line, also marked with circular data points, begins at approximately 24.20 when the number of examples is 0 and decreases to approximately 23.70 at 8, with intermediate values of approximately 24.00 at 2 and 23.50 at 4.
